result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. The `Landscape*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass.

The change is one condition in `LandscapeContributorsAggregator.getAllTeams()` (`codeanalyzer/.../landscape/analysis/LandscapeContributorsAggregator.java`). An unmatched contributor is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Configured teams are untouched.

A blank latest-commit date already counts as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank dates, so I added no extra handling for it.

I didn't add a test for the new filtering.
